info.title: CarbonIQ FinTech API
info.summary: The bank-facing layer for construction carbon intelligence: PCAF Part C insurance-associated emissions, the capital book, the GCF pipeline, taxonomy alignment and covenants.
info.description:
Generated from the running router by `npm run docs:openapi`; `tests/api-contract.test.js` fails the build when it drifts from the code.

**Authentication.** Send the key in `X-API-Key`. Name the person acting in `X-Actor`. Every operation states the scope it requires (`x-scope`); a refusal is `403 SCOPE_REQUIRED` naming the scope required and the scopes held.

**Two shapes.** `application/json` is the shape each route has always answered. `application/vnd.carboniq.v1+json` is the same body inside `{ data, meta, error }`; ask for it with `Accept`, `X-Envelope: 1` or `?envelope=1`. Every response says which in `X-Api-Envelope`. The legacy shape stays for the whole of v1; the envelope becomes the default in v2 — see docs/API-CONTRACT.md.

**Paging.** A list answers whole until asked for a page with `limit`; a page carries `page.nextCursor` to pass back as `cursor`.

**Errors.** One shape, always: `{ error, message, remedy?, details?, requestId }`. Quote `requestId` when asking for help; it finds the log line, the audit row and the error report.

get.summary: Health check — no credential required
get.description: Reports the running commit, because "the fix did not work" and "the fix has not been deployed" look identical from a browser and the second is far more common. The storage block says which store was **asked for** as well as which is running: "the variable never took" and "the store is unreachable" look identical too. Names and yes/no only — no value can reach the wire. No credential required.

decision.description:
approved  — Accept all AI-recommended covenant terms as-is.
modified  — Accept with specific threshold changes (requires modifications array).
rejected  — Reject all recommendations; agent run must be re-submitted.
This decision and its rationale are immutably recorded per EU AI Act Art. 22.

get.summary: The entity's own declaration about external assurance
get.description: Three states and not two: assured, not assured, and not declared. Whether a third party has audited these figures cannot be derived from anything held here, so it is recorded by the entity or reported absent. Requires the `read` scope.

put.description: A declaration that cannot be stored is refused rather than accepted: an entity told its statement was saved on a runtime that cannot save it is worse off than one told plainly. Requires the `write` scope.

post.summary: Sign in
post.description: Exchanges an email address and a password for a session token. Send the token on every later request as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. This is the only route that needs no credential. No credential required.

email.description: The address the account was created with. Case is not significant.

post.summary: Sign out
post.description: Ends the session the request carried. Idempotent. A session is a row, not a signed token, so signing out is a delete and takes effect at once. Requires the `read` scope.

get.summary: The account this request is acting as
get.description: Answers for a session token. An API key has no account and is told so. Requires the `read` scope.

post.summary: Change the caller's own password
post.description: Every other session that account holds ends, and a fresh one is issued here. Requires the `read` scope.

post.summary: Put a GCF candidate on the capital book
post.description: Writes the origin link, the screening verdict as it stood today and the pledged mitigation once and never again. No emission line is copied across: the investment's lines are the bank's own attributed inventory, and the record's mitigation is a project-level claim against a counterfactual. Requires the `write` scope.

get.summary: What is waiting: the gate, the two rankings, and the barrier each structure leaves standing
get.description: There is no overall rank to sort on. The two streams rank on different impact metrics, so two candidates legitimately hold rank 1 — one merged league table on carbon per dollar puts every adaptation project last. Requires the `read` scope.

get.summary: The book a committee reads, over the capital book and the GCF pipeline at once
get.description: The desk computes nothing: every figure is returned by the engine that already owns it. Three emission claims are carried separately and never presented as one number. Requires the `read` scope.

post.description: A read. It issues no id, stores nothing and is idempotent — `storedNote` says so in the payload as well as on the screen. Both sides run on the commitment basis whatever the desk is displaying, or a facility written this morning would move nothing. Requires the `read` scope.

post.description: Claude extracts and classifies; the engine computes. The emission factor and the total are recomputed here from the factor table and are never taken from the model, because an LLM must not compute a figure that reaches a disclosure. Requires the `assess` scope.

get.summary: Concept Note input package — JSON, PDF or Word
get.description: It lays out every held input in GCF's section A-H order and marks each held, partial or external. It does not write the Concept Note. A package is never complete while an external input is outstanding. Requires the `read` scope.

get.description: Requires the `read` scope. Reference data: cacheable for 3600s, answers 304 to a matching If-None-Match.

get.summary: The pipeline on three boundaries that never merge
get.description: Mitigation against a counterfactual, embodied A1-A5 of the asset itself, and financed emissions — which are not in this model at all and are said to be absent rather than left quietly missing. No key holds a figure combining two boundaries. Requires the `read` scope.

get.summary: One candidate on the three boundaries
The facts only the reporting entity can state

put.description: Nothing here is filled in on the entity's behalf. What is not recorded is reported absent in the disclosure with the clause that requires it. Requires the `write` scope.

get.summary: A period package, checksummed over its own canonical form
get.description: The export timestamp sits outside the hash, so two exports of identical records checksum identically and a changed checksum means the records changed. Requires the `read` scope.

post.summary: Verify and import a period package
post.description: Verified before anything is written and refused whole on any failure — half an imported period is a position nobody can reconcile. Every record still has to satisfy the schema: a transfer format is not an exemption. Requires the `write` scope.

get.summary: Seven structures, and the pipeline's mandate gap
get.description: Coverage is always reported with what it leaves standing, because the uncovered barrier is what kills a deal. Minimum concessionality means a structuring answer can be that the project does not need GCF support. Requires the `read` scope.

get.summary: The structure that fits one candidate, and the barrier it leaves standing
Contribution against NDC 3.0 — two ledgers, never summed

get.description: Recorded data replaces the shipped set entirely and is never merged with it; `source` says which is showing. Requires the `read` scope.

post.summary: Record a candidate. Ids are chosen by the caller so a record updates in place.
post.description: Every figure is `{value, tier}` rather than a bare number: without the tier a benchmark grid factor becomes a measured fact by the time it reaches a submission. Requires the `write` scope.

get.summary: Two ranked lists, never merged, on the weighting the reader set
get.description: Adaptation never ranks on carbon: its impact metric is beneficiaries per dollar. Three of GCF's six investment criteria rest on judgements this system does not hold and are named unscored; a missing component is dropped and its weight renormalised, never scored zero. Requires the `read` scope.

get.summary: Which two, why, and what could not be weighed
Results areas, IRMF core indicators, NDC 3.0 and the instrument catalogue
get.description: The evidence tiers here are GCF appraisal classes — measured, modelled, benchmark, declared — and are deliberately not PCAF's 1-5 data-quality scale. Requires the `read` scope. Reference data: cacheable for 3600s, answers 304 to a matching If-None-Match.

get.summary: SLFRS S1/S2 and GRI lines, with what it could not state
get.description: A pipeline of financed projects is not the bank's inventory, so the inventory lines are reported absent with the clause that requires them and where the figure actually comes from. The checklist is answered from the report, so it can fail. Requires the `read` scope.

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: The reporting year. Defaults to the current one.

parameters.name: bau
parameters.description: Cumulative BAU tonnage, if the share of the national target is wanted.

get.summary: The accreditation gate: eligible, flagged, excluded
get.description: A gate, not a score. A category A project is excluded rather than down-ranked, because down-ranking drifts a pipeline towards projects that touch nobody. `flagged` exists because a finding is not always a verdict. Requires the `read` scope.

get.summary: List this organisation's jobs, newest first

post.summary: Enqueue a job
post.description: Answers 202 with the job. In inline mode the job has already run; in postgres mode poll GET /v1/jobs/{jobId}. Requires the `assess` scope.

payload.description: The handler's input — for a report job, the body the synchronous route takes.

get.summary: One job
Download what the job produced
get.description: Refused with a 409 while the job is still queued or running, and with a 404 where it produced no document — the refusal says which and where the result is. A document is collected in full and checked before it is sent, never streamed. Requires the `read` scope.

get.summary: The job types this deployment runs
This process's counters — JSON or Prometheus text
get.description: One process's view, and the payload says so: the platform log drain is the cross-instance one. Requests are counted by route pattern rather than by path, or a busy id would become its own series. Requires the `read` scope.

post.summary: NDC and SDG alignment for a project
post.description: Reduction and removal are two commitments and are never summed: no key anywhere holds their total. Only the years falling inside 2026-2035 count against a 2026-2035 commitment. Requires the `assess` scope.

post.summary: Generate an SLGFT Green Loan Certificate
post.description: The tier is assigned from the governed intensity bands, so the certificate records the baseline version behind its own classification. The audit hash covers the tier that was assigned, not the bands that assigned it, so a later change to the bands does not invalidate a certificate already issued. Requires the `write` scope.

post.summary: Verify a certificate against its own audit hash
post.description: The stamp sits inside the hash, so the verifier reads it off the certificate with a legacy fallback — every already-issued certificate still verifies. Requires the `read` scope.

get.summary: SLGFT framework metadata, and the intensity screen in force
get.description: The framework is fixed by the published document; the intensity screen beside it is not in that document and is governed here, so this reports what is actually in force rather than a second constant. Requires the `read` scope.

get.summary: The OpenAPI 3.1 document, generated from the router
get.description: Never hand-written: every operation is a route Express registered, its request schema is the one `validate()` holds it to, and its scope is what the scope resolver returns. A test fails the build when the committed file and the router disagree. No credential required.

post.summary: Move an assessment through draft, under review and locked
post.description: Only a locked assessment enters the disclosure, and a locked one is never edited — only superseded. Locking one version supersedes the previously locked one, so a policy-year never has two. Requires the `write` scope.

get.summary: The annual disclosure — JSON, PDF or Word
get.description: Built from locked assessments only. A year holding none is refused with a 409 rather than rendered as a position of zero: an empty disclosure would read as "we insured nothing carbon-intensive", which is a different claim from "we have not measured yet". Requires the `read` scope.

get.summary: Locked totals, coverage and emissions-weighted data quality for a year
The flattened book: every policy with its project and client
The reporting-year position, with the DQ improvement plan and factor gaps
get.description: The disclosed data-quality score is premium-weighted (Box 6-3, p.107), with ceded premium substituted for treaty reinsurance (Box 6-4, p.108). A policy carrying no score is excluded from the weighting rather than counted as zero, and the count of what was excluded travels with the score. Requires the `read` scope.

get.summary: This year against last, on a basis that survives a change of book
get.description: A policy's reporting year is its inception year, so two years cover two different sets of policies: the movement is reported as fact alongside the note that it is not on its own a change in performance. Intensity and the emissions-weighted data-quality score are the measures that survive the change. Requires the `read` scope.

get.summary: What this deployment can actually persist

post.summary: PCAF Part A financed emissions for one asset
post.description: Data quality is weighted by outstanding amount (p.128), which is not how Part C weights it, so the two engines never share a weighting function. Avoided emissions are reported separately and never netted against the inventory (p.126). Requires the `read` scope.

get.summary: Part A asset classes, archetypes and the data-quality options for each
get.description: The option-to-score mapping is resolved per asset class and there is no global lookup: Option 2b is score 2 in one class and 3 in another, so one table applied across classes would be wrong for some of them, silently. Requires the `read` scope. Reference data: cacheable for 3600s, answers 304 to a matching If-None-Match.

post.summary: Write the disclosure narrative around figures the engine computed
post.description: An LLM never computes a figure that reaches a regulatory disclosure. Requires the `assess` scope.

precision.description: Round the attribution factor to this many decimals before use. Omit to carry the exact ratio.

post.summary: Extract the policy from a document. Claude classifies; the engine computes.
post.description: Requires the `assess` scope.

post.summary: Map BOQ lines to factor keys
post.description: A mapping that fails clears the table rather than leaving the previous rows standing — stale rows after a failed upload are what made the agent look static. Requires the `assess` scope.

post.summary: PCAF Part C insurance-associated emissions — the regulatory figure
post.description: A4 and A5 are the mandatory construction figure. B1, B4 and B7 are the optional use-stage line, reported separately and never summed with it. B2, B5 and B8 are a voluntary annex outside the PCAF figure altogether. Every figure carries its equation, inputs, factors and assumptions, so the registers and the data-quality score cannot contradict the arithmetic. Requires the `assess` scope.

precision.description: Round the attribution factor to this many decimals before use. Omit to carry the exact ratio.

get.summary: PCAF Part C rule → implementation → proving test
get.description: Output claims PCAF conformance and never endorsement: no artefact may say PCAF approved, certified or endorsed. Requires the `read` scope. Reference data: cacheable for 3600s, answers 304 to a matching If-None-Match.

post.summary: Data-quality scoring alone — nothing is persisted
post.description: So an intake form can show the score move as evidence is strengthened. The PCAF score itself does not move when one input improves, because the option has not changed; the internal aid does, and says so in words rather than numerals. Requires the `read` scope.

precision.description: Round the attribution factor to this many decimals before use. Omit to carry the exact ratio.

get.summary: Every factor table, with tier and source per row
get.description: Every row carries the quality tier it was drawn at and the source it came from, and a `gap` where a local figure is known to be missing. Requires the `read` scope. Reference data: cacheable for 3600s, answers 304 to a matching If-None-Match.

post.summary: The pre-filled, policy-gated client form
post.description: The policy gate decides which questions exist: CAR and EAR set the use stage to zero years by scope rule, so B1/B4/B7 are zero by rule rather than by omission, and a client-entered cover period applies within the gate and can never override it. Requires the `assess` scope.

get.summary: Dropdown options for the client form

post.summary: The disclosure report — PDF, Word or JSON
post.description: One content model in the order PCAF's disclosure checklist reads, rendered by one renderer, so a requirement satisfied in one document cannot go missing from the other. A document is collected in full and checked before it is sent, never streamed. Requires the `assess` scope.

post.summary: Supply the answers, compute, complete the run
post.description: Client factor overrides are held for the duration of this one call and are never a global: two resumes in one container must not share them. Requires the `assess` scope.

post.summary: Begin a run, pausing for the client to complete the form
post.description: A Part C assessment is not one request and one response: the agent ingests, pauses for the client, then resumes and computes. `durable` says whether the run will survive a restart on this deployment. Requires the `assess` scope.

The Carbon Finance Score (0-100) for a construction loan
EU, ASEAN, Hong Kong, Singapore and Sri Lanka alignment for one project
get.description: The five frameworks answer different questions and nothing here is summed into a single verdict. The Sri Lanka bands are regional judgement under governance, not a taxonomy threshold — the SLGFT sets no absolute figure per unit area. Requires the `read` scope.

post.summary: Generate a PCAF, GRI 305, TCFD, IFRS S2 or SLGFT report — JSON or PDF
post.description: A report built without a portfolio is stamped SAMPLE DATA on its face, and every report carries a `gaps` list of what it could not state. Entity-level narrative comes from recorded disclosures or is reported absent with the clause that requires it. Requires the `write` scope.

The pipeline templates this API can run
The build stamp, as an executable script the shell loads
get.description: It carries the build stamp and nothing that authenticates. It used to serve the dashboard's API key, which put a write-and-lock credential within reach of anyone who could load the page; since the browser signs in there is no credential left to serve. The value is emitted through JSON.stringify, so a stray character stays inside its string literal instead of becoming executable script. No credential required.

get.summary: List webhook subscriptions

post.summary: Register a webhook subscription
post.description: The signing secret is returned once, here, and only when this system generated it. A subscription that handed its own HMAC secret back on every read would be a secret that leaks to anything able to list subscriptions. Requires the `write` scope.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: An organisation key issued with `npm run key:create`. Add `X-Actor` to name the person.

BearerAuth.description: A session token from `POST /v1/auth/login`. The scopes it holds are the ones its role carries.

Error.description: Every error the API answers, in the shape it has always had.

error.description: A stable code, e.g. VALIDATION_ERROR, SCOPE_REQUIRED, NOT_FOUND, INTERNAL_ERROR.

remedy.description: What to do about it, where there is something to do.

details.description: Field-level detail on a validation error.

requestId.description: The correlation id; quote it when asking for help.

eventId.description: The error report id, on a 500.

Page.description: Present when the caller asked for a page with limit or cursor.

nextCursor.description: Opaque. Pass it back as `cursor` for the next page; null on the last page.

total.description: Items in the whole list, where the store can say.

yearsOfCover.description: Use-stage window for IDI/Property. Ignored for CAR/EAR by the scope gate.

gifa_m2.description: Drives A5.2 site energy and the per-m2 factor, so it is required

projectCost.description: Denominator of the attribution factor for project-specific cover

yearsOfCover.description: Use-stage window for IDI/Property. Ignored for CAR/EAR by the scope gate.

BadRequest.description: The request did not validate; `details` names the fields.

Unauthorized.description: No credential, or one that is invalid, revoked or expired.

Forbidden.description: The credential does not hold the scope this operation requires (`x-scope`); the body names the scope required and the scopes held.

RateLimited.description: Rate limit reached for this key.

NotModified.description: Not modified — the client's If-None-Match matched. Reference data; the operation says how long it may be cached.

Default.description: An error, in the shape every error takes.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Ask for a page of at most this many items (1–500; 50 when only cursor is given). Without it the whole list is answered.

cursor.name: cursor
cursor.description: The `page.nextCursor` of the previous page. Opaque.

envelope.name: envelope
envelope.description: Set to 1 to receive the envelope; the same as `Accept: application/vnd.carboniq.v1+json`.

XRequestID.description: The correlation id for this request; sent back when the caller supplied one.

XApiEnvelope.description: `legacy` for the shape the route has always answered, `v1` for the envelope.

XKeyScopes.description: The scopes the key holds, or `unscoped` for a key issued before scopes existed.
